name: guard
description: Guard: asks before destructive commands (rm -rf on broad paths, force push, git reset --hard, dd, mkfs, curl|sh, del /s, Remove-Item -Recurse -Force, DROP TABLE...), blocks real-looking secrets from being written or echoed, and checkpoints every file Claude edits, with /undo and a /checkpoints timeline. Hooks only: no model calls.

dangerGuard.title: Danger guard
dangerGuard.description: Ask before destructive shell and PowerShell commands

secretGuard.title: Secret guard
secretGuard.description: Block real-looking API keys, tokens, private keys and passwords from being written to files or put in commands

checkpoints.title: Checkpoints
checkpoints.description: Snapshot each file before Claude edits it, into .claude/checkpoints/<session>/ in the project (git-ignored)

allowList.title: Allowed commands
allowList.description: Comma-separated command prefixes the danger guard lets through (e.g. git push --force origin my-branch), or re:<regex>

secretAllowPaths.title: Paths allowed to hold secrets
secretAllowPaths.description: Comma-separated globs where the secret guard does not look (e.g. tests/fixtures/**)

maxFiles.title: Bulk delete: most files
maxFiles.description: A delete naming more files than this is a bulk delete and asks first

maxFileKB.title: Checkpoint: largest file (KB)
maxFileKB.description: Bigger files are listed but not saved

maxCheckpoints.title: Checkpoints kept
maxCheckpoints.description: The oldest are overwritten past this count

maxSnapshotFiles.title: Checkpoint: most files
maxSnapshotFiles.description: Most files one checkpoint saves (a destructive command on a folder)

language.title: Language
language.description: auto follows Claude Code's language setting, then the system locale; en, fr or ar (right to left)
